svg.title: Saving and server errors: Saving…, a failed save that keeps everything, refused agent and team removals
svg.desc: A: Edit team on Docs while saving: the footer button reads Saving… and is off, Cancel and Close are off, the fields are read-only. B: the save failed for a reason that isn't a field: a danger summary at the top with the server's words, focus on it, everything typed kept, Save changes on to try again. C: the save refused because a removed agent is still needed by a task: the summary names the task and the removed stub shows the same reason with Undo. D: Remove team refused in the footer confirm, naming the tasks. Light theme, existing tokens.
svg.text: Saving and server errors
Edit team on Docs. One request saves the whole team, so it lands whole or not at all. Words from copy.md; the server's own words are quoted as it sends them.
A · SAVING
Edit the Docs team
Team name
Handbook
… rows as before, read-only until the save answers …
Saving the team…
Cancel
Saving…
1 · Saving… / Creating…
The primary button reads "Saving…" (Edit) or "Creating…" (New), with a spinner, and is off; Cancel, Close
and Esc are off too, so the result is never lost. "Saving the team…" in the footer is a polite live region.
2 · Fields are read-only while saving
Inputs and the prompt are readonly, not disabled: still readable, focusable and read out, but they take no
typing; radios, swatches, selects, Add agent, remove and Undo are aria-disabled. The request is short, so the
result is always the team you saw. On success the panel closes; on a failure every field is editable again.
B · THE SAVE FAILED, NOT BECAUSE OF A FIELD
Edit the Docs team
Couldn't save the team
Couldn't reach Agentry. Check it's running, then try again.
Team name
Handbook
… every row as you left it, open rows still open …
Cancel
Save changes
3 · Everything typed is kept; Save is on to try again
The same summary as for field errors, with no links: its title and the server's message as sent (a 5xx's
body, or the network line). Focus moves to it. Nothing is reset, no row closes, the draft marks stay. The
request is all-or-nothing, so there is never a half-saved team to explain. Retrying sends the same team.
Title in danger-ink on danger-soft, 5.9:1; today's Banner title is text-danger, 3.2:1 (decision 10).
C · SAVE REFUSED: A REMOVED AGENT IS STILL NEEDED BY A TASK
Couldn't save the team: 1 thing to fix
researcher: still needed by task-182
"researcher is still needed by task-182: finish those first (dragging a task
to Done on the board finishes it as it is)"
Agents · one coordinates
researcher will be removed when you save
Undo
Still needed by task-182. Finish it first, or undo to keep researcher.
The other changes (the rename, the new agent) wait with it: nothing is saved yet.
Undo puts the row back and clears the problem; Save changes then saves the rest.
4 · The refusal goes where the change is
The server's 409 names the agent and the tasks; the summary links to the stub (Undo takes focus) and the stub
says it again in a line. task-182 links to the task; following it with unsaved changes asks first
(states-unsaved-and-replace.svg). The full server message is quoted in the summary, so its advice
(drag to Done) isn't lost. If an agent's rename is refused the same way, the error sits under its Name.
D · REMOVE TEAM REFUSED, IN THE FOOTER CONFIRM
… the panel body …
Remove the Docs team and its 4 agents?
Their prompts and what they learned go too.
It wasn't removed: "the Docs team is still needed by task-182, task-190:
finish those first (dragging a task to Done on the board finishes it as it is)"
Tasks: task-182, task-190
Keep
Remove
5 · Removal refused: say it in the confirm, keep the way back
Remove team is its own request (DELETE /api/teams/Docs, as today), not part of Save. On a 409 the confirm stays,
the server's words appear under the question with focus on them (tabindex -1), the tasks as links, and
Remove turns off until something changes; Keep (or Esc) returns the footer to normal. Unsaved edits in the
panel are untouched. Same words as RemoveDialog's "It wasn't removed" banner.
Your only team
Remove team is off, with its reason beside it in text: "Can't remove your only team: tasks need its coordinator."
(the server's rule, said before you try).
